admission.justification: MIK-R106 v2 rule 5 requires per-revision replacement, verbatim question/choice text and no send before Send; protocol validation and serving response construction jointly enforce that boundary, with bounded/verbatim parser and real retained-channel integration assertions.

applicability: Admitted offer-selections and request-explanation messages on a retained frame session’s host channel.
conditions: The existing session binding, request rate and replay checks run before dispatch.
Each selection map key includes repository, master, leaf, frame and revision; another offer to that key replaces its existing row.
The response pick names explainer as its default target and is removable; the host does not call a send/start path for either message.
exclusions: The explicit later Send is outside this host-message operation.
The 64-entry host map bounds transient stored selections; it is not durable revision history.
Presenter request recording can fail or be absent without altering the returned question text; recorded false remains explicit.

evidence: Approved MIK-R106 v2 rule 5 lines73–76; serving/canvas.py _selections_offered/_explanation_requested; canvas/protocol.py payload owners; named source assertions only.

statement: An admitted page selection offer becomes that revision’s one replaceable selection pick, and a page explanation request becomes a pick carrying the exact question; both target the explainer and preserve plain text without sending a message or starting a model turn.
